title: In-repo Daft auto-reply template still promises "It takes about 10 minutes" — briefing W1a-4 explicitly named "daft auto-reply if in-repo"
evidence:
### 8.1 Daft.ie Auto-Reply Template

> Thank you for your interest in [property address].
>
> To be considered for this property, please complete the application form below. It takes about 10 minutes and can be done on your phone.
detail: Briefing W1a-4: "KILL the lies ... wherever they appear (invite flow, form header, daft auto-reply if in-repo)"; Acceptance: "rg -i 'few minutes|10 minutes' clean or justified". This applicant-facing Daft auto-reply template is in-repo, neither clean nor justified.
recommended_fix: Rewrite §8.1 of the copy sheet with the honest checklist (~15 min once documents are gathered, both letters up front), matching the new email_client.gleam auto-reply copy.

title: Resend open/click tracking itself is not enabled by this change — only tags + UTM shipped; enablement deferred to a manual runbook
detail: Briefing W0-4 requires "Resend open/click tracking — on the invite/reminder sends, per the report". Tags/UTM landed, but open/click stays disabled until Moses does the DNS/dashboard step; PR must carry that runbook (not verifiable from repo).
recommended_fix: Verify the PR body documents the Resend domain-tracking + CNAME runbook steps for Moses, per the spec's "Ask First" item; no code change needed.

title: Stage-2 reminder gate is 2 days after stage-1 (landlord-click cadence), not the report's D+2/D+6 schedule
detail: Report E2 specifies "Two-stage doc-gathering series: D+2 'here's exactly what to gather', D+6 'still time — closes 13/08, continue where you left off'". Implementation sends both stages on landlord clicks with a 2-day gate; D+6 interval is not encoded.
recommended_fix: Acceptable if Moses drives clicks deliberately; otherwise widen the gate toward 6 days or document the cadence choice in the PR's Decisions & rationale.

title: Invite email subject still leads with "You're invited to apply for" — property name not first, against the spec's brand-voice constraint
evidence: let subject = "You're invited to apply for " <> property_name
detail: Spec Always-constraint: "Brand voice: ... property-name-first email subjects (mobile truncation)". Auto-reply and both reminder subjects were made property-first in this diff; the invite subject (same module, rewritten body) was left suffix-positioned.
recommended_fix: Change invite subject to property_name <> " — you're invited to apply" to match the auto-reply/reminder pattern.
